chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu Hamzah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام.
These are two disputants who dispute concerning their Lord.
Then those who disbelieved in the wilayah of Ali, for them garments of Fire shall be cut out.

key_terms.بِوِلَايَةِ: in the wilayah, meaning divinely appointed authority and allegiance

ai.seo_question: How is Qur'an 22:19 interpreted in relation to the wilayah of Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a tafsir of the verse by applying it to belief in the wilayah of Ali عليه السلام. It identifies rejection of his wilayah with disbelief and connects it to punishment in the Fire, highlighting the theological significance of wilayah in Shia tradition.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Barqy, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Hamza,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of the Exalted
[22:19] These are two disputants who dispute about their Lord; then (as to) those who disbelieve
in the Wilayah of Aliasws, for them are cut out garments of Fire’.
en.sarwar: 51. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Uramah from Ali ibn Hassa’n from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir who has said the following. “I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most High.
. . the human being realizes that it is the truth (God) who is the true Guardian. .” [18:44]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “It is the Wilaya of Imam Ali’s (Leadership with Divine Authority).”
